classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the roof height from two given heights, then combine the areas of all exposed faces.

content.prompt: Calculate the surface area of the composite solid.

spec.description: Unshaded house-shaped pentagonal prism. The front cross-section is on the left and depth extends upwards and rightwards. Retains both roof-slope dimensions, three separate 8 cm dimensions, the 11 cm central height, the roof baseline and both right-angle markers.
spec.mathematics: Front cross-section: width 8 cm, rectangular height 8 cm, total height 11 cm, two roof slopes of 5 cm. Prism length 8 cm. Roof triangle height is 3 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: All displayed dimensions and construction marks are permanent student givens; no calculated measurements or answers appear.

answer.worked:
Roof triangle height: $11-8=3\text{ cm}$.

$$\begin{align*}
\text{Base triangles} &= 2\left(\frac12\times8\times3\right)=24\text{ cm}^2\\
\text{Base rectangles} &= 2(8\times8)=128\text{ cm}^2\\
\text{Side rectangles} &= 2(8\times8)=128\text{ cm}^2\\
\text{Top rectangles} &= 2(5\times8)=80\text{ cm}^2\\
\text{Bottom rectangle} &= 8\times8=64\text{ cm}^2\\
\text{Total surface area} &= 24+128+128+80+64\\
&=424\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
